mapper.select: select COALESCE((SELECT f.wh_file_ori_name FROM lib_wish_file_book f WHERE w.wish_id = f.wish_id), '') AS file_name, w.wish_id, title, author, publisher, userid from lib_wish w where (title like CONCAT('%', #{sKey}, '%') or author like CONCAT('%', #{sKey}, '%')) and userid = #{userid} order by w.wish_id desc limit #{recordCountPerPage} offset #{firstIndex}
select count(*) from lib_wish w where (title like CONCAT('%', #{sKey}, '%') or author like CONCAT('%', #{sKey}, '%')) and userid = #{userid}
